services.desc: Save valuable time and travel on your schedule with Lite Flight private charters. Fly directly from the airport closest to your home or business to the airport closest to your destination - without long drives, traffic, or crowded terminals. We offer a wide range of aircraft options to fit your travel needs and budget, including helicopters, piston airplanes, and VIP-configured private jets. Whether you are traveling for business, family vacations, special events, or weekend getaways, our team can arrange the right aircraft for your trip.
